name: Jets to Brazil
label: Jade Tree
lede: Blake Schwarzenbach came out of Jawbreaker's breakup, got turned down by Geffen, and took a band name off a poster in Breakfast at Tiffany's. The first album sold more than anything else Jade Tree ever released.

eras.title: New York, a four-track, and two contracts to shake
eras.text: After Jawbreaker ended, Blake Schwarzenbach moved to New York and started over on a four-track. He and his new bassist were both still tied to major labels, and getting free of them came first.

years.cap: Blake Schwarzenbach at the Middle East Downstairs, Cambridge, MA
years.h: Schwarzenbach moves to New York and records over a drum machine
years.p: After [[Jawbreaker|ec88cdc3-0517-4951-b5ef-7323e7316db0]]'s breakup, [[Blake Schwarzenbach|c7d68007-b688-426f-a496-08467a0a6f44]] makes four-track recordings with bassist [[Jeremy Chatelain|29c980d7-b22b-4b16-ac37-d3dff47c00a5]] of Handsome.

years.h: Geffen passes, and both men walk out of their major-label contracts
years.p: Schwarzenbach was still signed to Geffen and Chatelain to Epic. When Geffen declined to sign Jets to Brazil, both were released.

years.h: A poster in Breakfast at Tiffany's supplies the band's name
years.p: Drummer [[Chris Daly|6ece778e-233f-40b6-93c2-807129660b79]] of [[Texas Is the Reason|b93c736f-a82f-4cae-9e57-a60b12d7055f]] joins, and suggests Jets to Brazil after spotting it on a poster in the 1961 film.

years.cap: Jets to Brazil at the Middle East Downstairs, Cambridge, MA, c. 1998
years.h: Jade Tree books the first shows
years.p: The label signed Jets to Brazil off its demo and organized the first dates. The band plays live for the first time in April 1998.
years.xp: Jade Tree founder Tim Owens already knew Schwarzenbach and Daly from earlier label releases. The earliest shows were alongside The Promise Ring and Jimmy Eat World.

years.h: Europe comes before the album does
years.p: Labelmates [[The Promise Ring|63a6fae8-d39e-4de6-bfd4-9bcbf489a565]] take Jets to Brazil to Europe for the summer, months before the debut is out.

years.cap: Schwarzenbach, Chatelain and Daly the night they arrive in Memphis to record, August 1998
q: The worst album I have ever heard.
years.src: Wikipedia: Orange Rhyming Dictionary · Wikipedia: Jets to Brazil
years.h: Twelve days in Memphis give Jade Tree its best seller
years.p: Recorded at Easley McCain with [[J. Robbins|3babd931-a940-43a8-b629-d7aed5b821d9]] in August 1998, Orange Rhyming Dictionary outsells everything else on the label. Pitchfork gave it 8.7.
years.xp:
The sessions were spread over two weeks. Schwarzenbach said recording outside New York let them "immerse ourselves in the making of this thing." Pitchfork's Brent DiCrescenzo wrote that the lyrics had more room to breathe.

Not everybody was sold. The Sun-Sentinel's Rachel Phillips hated it, and AllMusic's Mike DaRonco said the band lived up to the hype.

The closing acoustic song, Sweet Avenue, later had a strange second life on peer-to-peer networks, where it was often mislabeled as a [[Damien Rice|2119beb8-6ac5-4f21-82a4-b831c90c0024]] song.

eras.title: A second guitarist and a piano
eras.text: With a second guitarist in the band, Schwarzenbach could move to keyboards, and the second album sounded bigger and more layered. It became their best-charting record and took them to Japan.

years.cap: Jets to Brazil at the Middle East, Cambridge, MA, June 2000
years.h: A second guitarist frees Schwarzenbach for keyboards
years.p: [[Brian Maryansky|c84367ba-2cbc-4884-9562-89e9409565aa]], formerly of [[The Van Pelt|4ce909db-0da6-4eed-bfe6-6c1f71e265b0]], takes the guitar. Blake Schwarzenbach can now focus on vocals and keyboards.

years.h: Four Cornered Night sells over 48,000 copies in the US
years.p: Recorded March to May 2000 at Inner Ear with [[J. Robbins|3babd931-a940-43a8-b629-d7aed5b821d9]], it peaks at No. 19 on Billboard's Heatseekers chart.
years.xp:
Schwarzenbach wrote part of it on an upright piano at his mother's farm in Nova Scotia, a change from his Roland digital keyboard. The piano ended up on four tracks.

Exclaim! said it ultimately beats the debut on songwriting and cohesiveness, and Ox-Fanzine called it even better than expected.
play: You're Having the Time of My Life

years.cap: Jets to Brazil at the Middle East, Cambridge, MA, June 2000
years.h: Jets to Brazil hits the US road with Cave In and Shiner
years.p: Behind Four Cornered Night, the band plays the US with [[Cave In|f3c95ad4-215b-4519-8660-84c9f467da05]] and [[Shiner|85e4c862-bafe-48a2-a7af-b87cc3d8a7f3]].

years.cap: Schwarzenbach at the piano, The Catalyst, Santa Cruz, April 29, 2001
years.h: Japan in June, after a spring of US dates
years.p: Jets to Brazil tours the US in April and May with The Love Scene and New End Original, then flies to Japan in June 2001.
years.xp: Wikipedia has the Japanese tour in June with Burning Airlines, J. Robbins' band.

eras.title: The long record, the cancelled tour, the quiet end
eras.text: The third album ran nearly 68 minutes and split its reviewers. The tour behind it was cancelled on opening day, the drummer left, and less than a year after the record came out Jets to Brazil was finished, for reasons nobody spelled out.

years.h: A cat named Chinatown gets a song on Perfecting Loneliness
years.p: Recorded in April and May 2002 with [[J. Robbins|3babd931-a940-43a8-b629-d7aed5b821d9]], the album runs nearly 68 minutes. Cat Heaven is for Blake Schwarzenbach's cat Chinatown, who got sick and died.
years.xp:
The band directed the video for Cat Heaven itself. Punk Planet's Kyle Ryan called the album "an amazing piece of work." Pitchfork's Eric Carr heard a few decent arrangements recycled until nothing was left.

Chinatown the cat shared a name with a song on Orange Rhyming Dictionary.

years.h: The headlining tour dies on the day of its first show
years.p: Jets to Brazil had planned US dates for October and November behind Perfecting Loneliness. The whole tour is called off on opening day, because of an illness in the band.

years.big: "...had run its course, and ceased to be fun/rewarding for me."
years.h: Daly leaves, and Matt Torrey of MK Ultra takes the kit
years.p: Chris Daly's reason, when Blake Schwarzenbach announced his exit on January 9. Torrey was named his replacement on March 12 and plays the May to July 2003 tour.

years.cap: Jets to Brazil at The Catalyst, Santa Cruz
years.h: The summer tour ends, and so does the band, with no reason given
years.p: By fall 2003, less than a year after Perfecting Loneliness, Jets to Brazil is done. Wikipedia lists the reasons as unspecified.

eras.title: Back to the old bands, mostly
eras.text: Schwarzenbach taught English and cycled through new bands before Jawbreaker finally came back. Daly returned to Texas Is the Reason. A Jets to Brazil reunion stayed a maybe.

years.h: Daly takes Texas Is the Reason to Irving Plaza
years.p: Daly reunites with [[Texas Is the Reason|b93c736f-a82f-4cae-9e57-a60b12d7055f]] for shows at Irving Plaza in New York, and tours with them again in 2012 and 2013.

years.h: A Hunter College English teacher starts The Thorns of Life
years.p: [[Blake Schwarzenbach|c7d68007-b688-426f-a496-08467a0a6f44]] teaches English at Hunter College while The Thorns of Life runs until August 2009. [[Forgetters|0d3f4272-e36c-4dbe-b62e-421a1a6c19ed]], with [[Against Me!|a66ebddc-ff04-46b8-820a-15c63e80dba1]] drummer Kevin Mahon, follows.

years.h: Jawbreaker returns, for Chicago's Riot Fest
years.p: Announced twenty-one years after the band ended.

years.cap: Schwarzenbach with Jawbreaker at The Fillmore, San Francisco
years.h: Schwarzenbach leaves the door open on Jets to Brazil
years.p: At a Q&A for the Jawbreaker documentary Don't Break Down, he says a Jets to Brazil reunion may happen someday, but [[Jawbreaker|ec88cdc3-0517-4951-b5ef-7323e7316db0]] comes first.
